decisions.reason: Correctly attributes failure to fs-ext@2.1.1 install script (node-gyp configure build) pulled by dsh-session-persistence-jsonl, with missing Windows MSVC/VS as the cause.
Explains the top-level flock import forces fs-ext to load on Windows at boot, so --ignore-scripts only moves the failure from install time to boot time.
Distinguishes Windows named kernel semaphore (acquireLockHandleWin32) from POSIX flock, notes the fs-ext flock branch is dead code on Windows, and requires POSIX keep real flock.

Solid pnpm patchedDependencies plan with entry platform branch and verification; but the described patch neutralizes the install script unconditionally, so its own claim that POSIX still compiles the native addon is not achieved by the stated mechanism — non-Windows native preservation is asserted, not actually implemented in the plan.
Explicitly avoids installing Visual Studio, uses the repository-managed patch mechanism, and correctly rejects overrides/ignore-scripts without confusing local patching with upstream modification.
Never cites DSH-0.1.3-A1-03; explicitly declines to identify the card, only describing the matching scenario.

caps.reason: Plan installs no Visual Studio and states so as final advice.
Explicitly rejects --ignore-scripts as boot-breaking; the final plan also patches the entry to be loadable.
Uses a repository-local pnpm patch; no upstream edit or release required.
Windows keeps the semaphore; the no-op stub covers only the dead Windows flock path and POSIX keeps real flock.
